content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm trying to install the [product_name] demo software on my MacBook Pro. After downloading and opening the files, when I click the setup file for Mac, I get a message saying it's not possible to open it on my device. I'm not sure why this happens. I need this for my studies and work. Is there anyone who can assist? Best regards, [user_name]

Hi, Could you specify which version of [product_name] you’re attempting to install, and what Mac OS version is running on your MacBook? This could be a case of unsupported OS. Take a look at the requirements description for [product_name] [version_no] on Mac OS: [url] Does your Mac OS version align with those listed? Hope this helps, [user_name]

1. Make sure you are using the x86_64 version of Java runtime. 2. Check that the Java runtime version is compatible. 3. [product_name] [version_no] or earlier requires Java runtime version 8; [product_name] [version_no] needs Java runtime version 11. 4. Install or update the software in a new folder. You can run java_home to check which Java version your system is using. If multiple versions are present, the highest version is chosen by default. If you prefer a different one, set it manually. Note: Always use the x86_64 Java binary, not the aarch64 or Apple Silicon version. The installer also relies on Java (InstallAnywhere).

On macOS, the Java runtime can be found at /Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/. To clarify, [company_name]’s [product_name] for Mac doesn’t include a Java VM, so you need to download it separately. On my Mac, I have both version 8 and version 11 Java runtimes in x86_64 format. While [company_name] doesn't officially support the latest macOS, I haven't encountered any problems. I use Sonoma and run both the [version_no] installation CD and upgraded [version_no] web download without issues.

analysis.insight_summary: The main user experiences problems installing the [product_name] demo version on a MacBook Pro, receiving an error about the file not opening. Contributors mention common compatibility concerns with Mac OS versions and Java runtime architectures, stressing that the correct Java version and binary are essential. It’s also noted that [company_name]’s support for newer Mac OS versions is limited, yet with appropriate configuration, installation is feasible.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates an easy installation and smooth functioning of the [product_name] demo software on their MacBook Pro, without facing compatibility barriers, to support both their educational and professional needs.
